title: A1 Final Review Part 3: Past Cont & Present Perf
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has superado con éxito la tercera parte del Gran Repaso Final de A1.

stages.title: Gran Repaso: Past Cont y Present Perfect

parts.visual: Past Continuous: Una acción en progreso en el pasado (que puede ser interrumpida). Estructura: was / were + verbo(-ing). I was working when you called. They were discussing the budget.
parts.audio: Past Continuous for actions in progress in the past, often interrupted. Structure: was or were plus I-N-G verb. I was working when you called.

parts.visual: Present Perfect: Experiencias o resultados presentes, sin decir la fecha exacta. Estructura: have / has + participio (terminado en -ed, o irregular). I have finished the report. Have you ever been to Paris? He hasn't arrived yet.
parts.audio: Present Perfect for past experiences or present results, without saying exactly when. Structure: have or has plus past participle. I have finished the report. Have you ever been to Paris?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del Past Continuous o Present Perfect.

questions.question: I ____ working on the presentation at 8 PM yesterday. (Estaba).
They ____ reviewing the contract when the client arrived. (Estaban).
What ____ you doing when the system crashed?
questions.explanation: Pregunta de Past Continuous con 'you' = were.

questions.question: I was typing an email when he ____. (Llamó - interrupción).
questions.explanation: La interrupción va en Past Simple: called.

questions.question: I have never ____ this software before. (Usado).
questions.explanation: Después de have/has, el verbo va en participio: used.

questions.question: Have you ____ managed a team? (¿Alguna vez...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre experiencia de vida = ever.

questions.question: I haven't finished the report ____. (Todavía).
questions.explanation: Negación al final de la oración = yet.

questions.question: We have ____ launched the product. (Acabamos de).
Don't worry, I have ____ booked the flight. (Ya).
questions.explanation: Acción completada antes de lo esperado = already.

questions.question: ____ you seen my keys? I can't find them. (¿Has...?).
questions.explanation: Pregunta sin fecha específica, buscando un resultado presente: Have you seen...?

questions.question: He has never ____ a presentation in English. (Dado/Hecho).
I was ____ lunch when the manager arrived. (Comiendo/Teniendo).
We ____ not expecting this result. (No estábamos).
Has the CEO ____ the new strategy? (Aprobado).
I ____ talking to the client for an hour yesterday. (Estuve).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la respuesta correcta (was, were, have, has, o el participio).
